title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libreswan security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in libreswan, an implementation of IPsec and IKE for Linux used to build secure VPN tunnels. These include use-after-free, denial of service via malformed X.509 certificates, and null pointer dereferences in various IKEv2 components. Red Hat has issued an important security advisory providing fixes and enhancements by rebasing libreswan to version 5.3.3. The update addresses four specific CVEs related to memory corruption and denial of service issues.
